description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Gpts are gpts in the Evaluation Analysis area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Gpts are gpts: An early look at the labor market impact potential of large language models”. The page names Tyna Eloundou, Sam Manning, Pamela Mishkin, Daniel Rock as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
